events.description: Rumsfeld sends a snowflake memo to Steve Cambone saying he has no visibility into who the bad guys are in Afghanistan or Iraq, that intelligence is not actionable, and that human intelligence is woefully deficient.

Rumsfeld sends a snowflake memo to Steve Cambone stating he has no visibility into who the 'bad guys' are in Afghanistan or Iraq, that intelligence lacks actionable content, and that the US is woefully deficient in human intelligence.
actors: Office of the Secretary of Defense

relationships.detail: Rumsfeld addressed the memo to Cambone and asked him to discuss and respond on intelligence deficiencies.
relationships.quote: We are woefully deficient in human intelligence. Let's discuss it.

Cambone is tasked to respond to Rumsfeld's memo.
Rumsfeld is a consumer of intelligence from the community and criticizes it as lacking actionable human intelligence.

key_claims: Rumsfeld stated in Sept 2003 that he had no visibility into who the adversaries were in Afghanistan or Iraq.
He said US intelligence reporting sounded comprehensive but contained nothing actionable when probed.
He judged the US woefully deficient in human intelligence.
